status: Controller G11 verified actual Gateway/User Nacos discovery, fixed configuration and governance with Redis and private MySQL; G9 separately verified the real logout trace chain with a test-only consumer.
readiness: auth public-key configuration and authoritative Redis GET available, and enabled governance rules healthy

nacos.namespaceBehavior: Each explicit discovery/configuration namespace overrides NACOS_NAMESPACE; governance uses its own KNODE_GOV_NACOS_NAMESPACE.
nacos.configurationImport: NACOS_CONFIG_IMPORT is resolved before Spring Config Data; explicit SPRING_CONFIG_IMPORT takes precedence.
nacos.routeRefresh: Refresh scope and gateway route cache are refreshed on configuration change.
nacos.groups: NACOS_DISCOVERY_GROUP maps to spring.cloud.nacos.discovery.group, default DEFAULT_GROUP; it must equal the User registration group USER_NACOS_GROUP. NACOS_GROUP applies only to Gateway config and defaults KNODE_SERVICE; KNODE_GOV_NACOS_GROUP applies only to Gateway governance. These groups do not implicitly share a value.
nacos.validation: Nacos 3.0.3 and the actual Gateway JAR routed to an SDK-registered loopback HTTP fixture only in the exact custom discovery group; healthy DEFAULT_GROUP and another group were not routed. Explicit deregistration, re-registration and fixture restart recovered; the test disabled the Spring Cloud load-balancer cache. The fixture is not User and does not establish User Nacos wiring. Controller G11 separately verified authenticated Nacos 3.0.3 with actual Gateway/User JARs, two isolated namespaces and different discovery, config and governance groups. Real login and readiness passed; other-namespace changes were isolated. Invalid User relay config caused 503 readiness and recovery; the last valid batch size 2 released two of three real logout events until recovery at 3. User flow-rule missing/invalid readiness and direct/Gateway 429 enforcement and clearing were verified. Gateway load-balancer cache was disabled. G11 evidence: reports/microservices/g11-real-nacos-c5e6b6dbdc1c/result.json

auth: Shared SDK v0.2 plus nonblocking authoritative session GET; no positive cache

sentinelTransport.commandPort: csp.sentinel.api.port; official simple HTTP listener binds all interfaces and has no authentication; isolate/firewall it
sentinelTransport.heartbeatIp: csp.sentinel.heartbeat.client.ip only advertises the IP; it does not bind the listener

localPorts.gatewayManagement: 19090 explicitly selected for local run; without a separate management.server.port, management shares the application port
localPorts.userManagement: USER_MANAGEMENT_PORT defaults to 19092 and loopback, per User G8 runtime input
localPorts.prometheus: 19091 explicitly selected in the local runbook

authRedisTls: Default true; full certificate and hostname verification. False must be explicit for a deliberately isolated plaintext server. VM native TLS not verified.
localInitialization: scripts/microservices/infra/nacos-init.js; verify-only separate fresh namespace and group; see deploy/microservices/nacos/initialization.json.
